mapper.insert: INSERT INTO institution_file_system ( system_code, system_name, description, keshi, group_path, created_by ) VALUES ( #{systemCode}, #{systemName}, #{description}, #{keshi}, #{groupPath}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed As isFixed, description, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed As isFixed, description, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE keshi = #{keshi} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT id, system_code AS systemCode, system_name AS systemName, is_fixed AS isFixed, description, group_path AS groupPath, created_time AS createdTime FROM institution_file_system WHERE ( keshi IS NULL OR ( keshi = #{keshi} AND ( group_path IS NULL OR group_path = #{GroupPath} ) ) ) ORDER BY created_time DESC
